messages:
anita: Heads-up: PMs reported that the console error badges are noisy and use cryptic internal codes. We should define a tiny, stable surface for clients and the console.
raj: Proposed constraint: keep the runtime contract to an enum + two one-line hints max. That keeps SDKs and dashboards lightweight.
marta: I like a 4-class model but different names: RETRYABLE, LIMIT, DEGRADED, ACTION_REQUIRED. Enums must be stable (dont rename).
sienna: Rename note: ACTION_REQUIRED sounds more actionable than PERMANENT/TERMINAL. Good. For display text we can map RETRYABLE -> "Try again", LIMIT -> "Limit reached", DEGRADED -> "Reduced features", ACTION_REQUIRED -> "Needs action".
anita: Also need a machine hint for client logic: can_fallback (true/false) and retry_policy (exponential/simple/none). Keep values small.
raj: Telemetry rule: emit metric tag error_category (enum) and retain previous internal tag legacy_code during rollout. Dashboards should filter by error_category once stable.
marta: Implementation sketch for API response: error_category (enum), ui_message (short), retry_hint (retryable/no-retry), can_fallback (true/false), quota_retry_after (secs optional). Example: {"error_category":"LIMIT","ui_message":"Limit reached","retry_hint":"no-retry","can_fallback":"false","quota_retry_after":"1200"}.
sienna: Console UX suggestions: show icon + ui_message; tooltip includes brief next step and the retry policy. Keep tooltip copy under 100 chars for readability.
anita: Routing policy: automatic fallback allowed when can_fallback==true and error_category==RETRYABLE or DEGRADED. LIMIT should not auto-fallback unless tenant policy allows burst credit.
raj: Add headers: X-Error-Category and X-Fallback-Used for observability in customer logs. Also emit X-Retry-After for LIMIT when present.
marta: Rollout plan: feature-flag the new fields, emit both headers for 3 weeks, run a dashboard migration job to remap legacy codes -> new enums.
sienna: UX color palette: RETRYABLE=amber, DEGRADED=orange, LIMIT=blue, ACTION_REQUIRED=crimson. Agree?
anita: Blue for LIMIT to reduce panic. Maybe reuse shield icon for ACTION_REQUIRED.
infra-bot: notice: client-error-surface v2 feature-flag scheduled for canary 2025-01-15T01:00Z.
raj: One more: SDK guidance doc should include a tiny decision table: when to retry, when to show CTA to upgrade, when to surface support link. Keep examples minimal.
marta: I'll draft the RFC with enum definitions, example payloads, header mapping, metric migration table, and rollout checklist. Will tag dashboard and SDK owners.
anita: Thanks — unless anyone objects to these four categories I'll move this into a PR.
